'''Stomper Two''' was a [[Void Jumper]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] who participated in the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. Alongside [[Stomper One (Void Jumper)|Stomper One]] and under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]]'s leadership, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] spearheaded the assault against [[Abeloth]]'s [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] through the corridors of the [[New Jedi Temple]].
